items.title: Fashion Style Teens
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: These eight trendy teens are here, and they are ready to show off their style! Choose your fashion with this array of designer outfits and trendy designs. Which fashion will add to your wardrobe?

items.title: Rich Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Want to experience a life of luxury? All eyes are on you when you are in these designer clothes! Make the hallways your own runway while showcasing your different styles. Cling to your lavish lifestyle and live your fancy life!

- Includes 12 wealthy skins
- Perfect for role playing

items.title: TNT++
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Ready for 20+ new custom types of TNT? Then this is the map for you. An old western mining town full of crazy TNT blocks that are sure to blow your mind!
If you are lucky some will give you loot but others will cause destruction.

- 20+ custom TNTs
- A western themed town
- Custom golems and baby dragons
- 2 skins

items.title: Crashed Plane Island
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Your plane has crashed on a strange Island your goal now is to survive and explore! 
Check out all the hidden secrets, treasures, and areas!

Includes:

- 1 Skin
- Survival Spawn
- Hidden Treasures

By KA Studios

items.title: Ducktopia
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Welcome to a paradise designed for ducks. Take a dip in the pool with a flock of ducks, or relax on the nearby beach chairs. Explore the village, or raise your own family of ducks!

+ Includes furniture models
+ 4 skins for duck lovers
+ 1 FREE skin

items.title: Frozen Factory
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Built in the middle of a frozen forest, this large factory houses plenty of hidden loots! Fly around in a helicopter, loot the factory, or just race your friends on snow mobiles.

+ Snow mobiles and a helicopter!
+ 4 cool skins
+ Various custom decorations

items.title: Skyblock Spooky
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Are you looking for a spooky skyblock world? Look no further, this Halloween skyblock world is perfect for you! Play this scary map alone or with a friend! Don't get scared!

+ Open world in the sky
+ Perfect for anyone who loves Halloween

By: ChewMingo

items.title: MERMAID!
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Make a splash with these cute mermaid skins! Choose any of these cute skins!

items.title: Space Rainbows
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Travel to far away with the Space Rainbows skins! Will you conquer the galaxy with this flamboyant drip?

+ Skin pack

items.title: Mean Teens
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Show off your diva side with this fashionable style! 

+ 8 HD diva skins
+ FREE skin: Reina
+ High standard of trendy, fashion & modern teens.

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Toys
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Become an epic robot or a cute plushie dinosaur! There are so many toys to choose from, who will you be?

+ 12 playful skins to choose from
+ Perfect for roleplaying with friends
+ FREE skin: Robot

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Mob Heroes
items.creator: Spectral Studios
items.description:
Enter the world of Mob Heroes and become a superhero in this brand new way to play survival!
Do you have what it takes to take down the Ender Dragon and become the next legendary Ender Hero?
This map features:
- 8 Mob themed superhero suits
- 16 unique and powerful abilities
- 7 incredible superhero bases to explore and make your own
- Multiplayer friendly, co-op and PvP!

items.title: Scary Halloween Teens
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
It is that time of year again, it is HALLOWEEN! The monsters are back and this time they won't make you any gifts!

+ 10 Scary Halloween Teens

items.title: Bedwars Teens
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Bed wars time! Show your superiority to your opponents with these bed wars outfits!

+17 Bedwars Teens skins

items.title: Anime School Teens
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
School is back! Put on these wonderful school outfits and impress all your friends!

+ 20 Anime School Teens skins

items.title: Fainting Goats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Have you ever heard of fainting goats?
Now you can meet them in person. The goats here are advanced and improved. They come with various cool features. But all these improvements come with a price: If they get scared, they faint.

=> New baa-utiful goat designs
=> Ride, tame, breed and paint goats
=> Enjoy various activities
=> 6 Baaa-utiful skins

items.title: Parkour Among Giants
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
The giants have taken over the world! Enjoy a parkour full of dangers and challenges to overcome; be careful where you walk, the giants have set traps and you don't want to get trapped! Play with friends or alone to try to reach the end.

- Ten different levels
- Two skins
- One skin free
- By DragonClub Studios

items.title: Slime Style
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Check out these slimes and their youthful style. Each one has a unique design and striking colours. You can stand out among friends with this incredible pack.

- Fourteen skins.
- Two totally free skins.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Retro Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Do you want to look more retro? You need these styles! Dress in a cute retro style with colorful vests in fashion!

- Twelve skins
- One skin free 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Orange Kingdom
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
This kingdom is not that old, but history can still be written, live here and write it yourself! Create your own adventure and, above all, enjoy this wonderful world.

- A wonderful 500x500 kingdom.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: SkyBlock Masters
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: This skin pack is for the masters of skyblock! If you love HD skins and sky themed skins then you'll love this pack. You can roleplay as a chest full of loot or a grumpy cloud monster. Good luck on your adventures up high in the sky!

items.title: Scary Zombies
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These zombie skins are horrifically awesome! If you weren't already a mindless zombie now is your chance. Pick a scary brain eater skin to roleplay with. Perfect as a Halloween costume or just for chasing your friends around with!

- 12 skins

items.title: Watermelon
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Watermelon is that delicious green and red fruit everybody loves! Now you can roleplay as watermelon demons. Or maybe you want to become a cute melon doggo? Stay fresh with this skin pack!

- 7 skins

items.title: MC Farm Animals
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: This skin pack is full of cute HD farm animals. Which lovable MC critter do you love most? Roleplay as a cute piggy, one of the many colorful sheep or an adorable horse! So many beautiful farm animals to choose from.
